name: Supernova 16CAA field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant supernova 16CAA, seen by Hubble.
label: supernova16caafield-hubble
story: Somewhere in this field a distant supernova found by Japan's Subaru telescope flared. Hubble added infrared light to the Subaru measurements, part of a hunt for far-off Type Ia supernovae that chart the history of cosmic expansion and dark energy.

claims.text: 16CAA is a target of program 14808, SUbaru Supernovae with Hubble Infrared (SUSHI)
SUSHI pairs Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam light curves of high-redshift Type Ia supernovae with Hubble infrared observations to improve dark energy constraints
